description: This is a PHP class file for a controller in the OpenCart admin panel, specifically handling scheduled tasks (crons). It defines a Cron class with an index method that loads cron settings, checks their status and schedule, and executes associated actions when due.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Controller class responsible for executing scheduled cron jobs based on their configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that retrieves scheduled tasks, checks if they are due, executes their actions, and updates their status.
